subject: Starter commit bands and volume discount options
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellie Tran <ellie.tran@veracity.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Starter commit and discount proposal (hosted API only)

Hi Ellie —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Based on the volume shape you shared and the use cases (chat assistants + nightly vector indexing), I put together three starter commit bands for our hosted API and a suggested approach for the first 3 months so you can ramp without long-term lock-in. Attached: starter_commit_options.pdf and rate_card_q1_2026.xlsx.

Summary (hosted API, USD):
- Starter (recommended for proof-of-value): $5,000/mo commit -> 10% off per-token list rates; no long-term SLA; pro-rata credit if next month scales above commit.
- Growth: $25,000/mo commit -> 16% off list; 99.9% availability SLO; onboarding support + 2 weeks priority queue.
- Scale: $100,000/mo commit -> 22% off list; reserved capacity conversation if you want Dedicated later.

We can also offer a one-time onboarding credit (applied to first invoice) of up to $5k for the Starter band, or up to $8k for Growth if you commit to a 3-month minimum ramp. Credits are not retroactive by default but can be applied pro-rata on the first billing cycle if we agree ahead of time.

Couple of clarifying asks so I can line up internal approvals:
1) Can you confirm expected average tokens/day and whether you expect spikes (we can size batching/kv cache recommendations if you share a sample traffic day).
2) Are you aiming for monthly or annual commit terms? We can do both; discounts increase for annual.
3) Any procurement timing constraints (PO, tax documents, or a preferred contract template)?

If this looks directionally right I can loop in our finance lead for formal pricing and Laura for approval on onboarding credits.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0128

Attachments: starter_commit_options.pdf (summary), rate_card_q1_2026.xlsx (per-token list rates + embed rates)

> Hi Ellie —
> 
> Thanks again for the call this morning. Based on the volume shape you shared ...

Thanks Monica — this is helpful and much appreciated. A few quick notes and questions from our side:

- Usage: ballpark is ~1.5M tokens/day now (mostly chat), expect steady growth to ~3M tokens/day over Q2 if experiments go well (~45M -> 90M tokens/month).
- Commitment preference: we prefer monthly commits for flexibility but will consider a 6- or 12-month band if the economics are compelling.
- Credits: onboarding credit is great. Two questions: can credit be applied retroactively to usage from the test week (we often run pilots where usage precedes the PO)?
- Pricing detail: can you confirm per-1M-token list price for text-gen and whether embeddings are priced differently (we use both heavily)? Your spreadsheet had columns but would like a simple line-item we can paste into our procurement email.
- Compliance: quick question — hosted API only for now. Any SLA exceptions for higher tiers? Also, do you support customer-managed key encryption for hosted?

Procurement is on the thread to flag timing — they typically need a quote + invoice line items to issue PO. Can you send a short price summary we can attach to an internal ticket?

Thanks —
Ellie
Director of Product, Veracity AI
ellie.tran@veracity.ai

Laura / Rishi — forwarding Veracity's follow-up. Key points: they prefer monthly commits but may do 6–12 months for better economics; current run-rate ~45M tokens/mo with likely ramp to 90M by Q2; they ask if onboarding credit can be applied retroactively for pilot week.

My recommended approach so we can move quickly:
- Offer a 3-month ramp: months 1–2 at Starter band ($5k/mo commit, 10% discount) with an onboarding credit up to $5k applied to Month 1. If they commit to a 3-month Growth band during month 2, pro-rate the credit to Growth pricing.
- For procurement flexibility: provide both monthly and annual quotes. If they choose 12-month commitment, apply Growth discount levels + 2% extra.
- For the pilot retroactivity ask: we can make a one-time retroactive credit up to $2k for pilot usage (exceptions need manager sign-off).

Can you confirm: 1) whether Finance is OK with the one-time retro credit and the $5k onboarding cap; 2) whether we can authorize up to 15% discount at deal desk without extra approvals (anything higher needs VP ok).

If approved I will send Ellie a one-page price summary (text lines they can paste to procurement) and the attached rate_card_xlsx.

Thanks —
Monica

- Finance note (Rishi): please confirm whether rebate/credit application should be handled as a prepaid credit on the invoice or as a separate credit memo (we typically prefer prepaid credits for easier PO reconciliation).
